title: The Promised Land
logline: An idealistic scout discovers a perfect new colony world, but needs a pilot to destroy a corporate surveyor ship trying to claim the land first.

roles.description: Starry-eyed, naive, genuinely believes in a better future.
Tired, completely disillusioned with corporate greed.
A massive corporate ship deploying claim beacons.
A megacorporation that turns planets into strip mines.

public_situation: The {role:development_corp} announces the discovery of a new garden world, {role:new_colony}, ripe for industrial development.
private_truth: The scout actually discovered the world first and promised it to a group of refugees, but the corporation hacked their nav-computer to steal the coordinates.

beats.public_change: The corporate surveyor begins dropping automated claim beacons across the planet.

missions.reason: The scout begs the pilot to scan the corporate beacons to prove they were deployed illegally.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the beacons are heavily armed and destroying the local ecosystem.

beats.public_change: The corporation files the official claim paperwork with the galactic registry.

missions.reason: The negotiator hires the pilot to fly to the surveyor ship and collect the hard-copy of the scout's original stolen logs.
missions.private_fact: The negotiator actually works for the corporation and is trying to destroy the evidence.

beats.public_change: The surveyor ship begins constructing its first strip-mining rig.

missions.reason: The scout pays the pilot everything they have to destroy the surveyor ship before the claim is finalized.
missions.private_fact: The corporate captain hails the pilot, offering to pay triple the scout's rate if they just fly away and let the mining begin.

player_choice.prompt: The surveyor ship is burning. The corporation is offering a massive bribe to look the other way.

options.label: Take the bribe and spare the ship

resolutions.summary: The corporate ship is destroyed. The scout leads the refugees to the pristine world, starting a peaceful new colony.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot fought off a megacorp to secure a new home for refugees.

resolutions.summary: The corporation successfully claims the planet and immediately begins strip-mining it. The scout is devastated.
The corporation finalizes the claim. The beautiful world is reduced to a toxic wasteland within a year.

loose_threads.detail: The corporation hacked the scout's nav-computer using naval intelligence backdoor codes.
The cynical negotiator admits they used to be exactly like the scout before the corporation broke them.

radio_hooks: New garden world discovered; {role:development_corp} shares skyrocket.

voice_direction.idealistic_scout: Bright, energetic, speaks with total conviction.
voice_direction.cynical_negotiator: Tired, completely disillusioned, speaks in a dull monotone.
